title: Dialogues
subtitle: B2 · Unit 4: B2 · Housing and city life: compare competing needs

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the speakers' goals and how each response changes the exchange. Read once for meaning, then cover the English and summarize each person's position.

steps.title: Neighbourhood consultation
steps.body: Residents discuss an invented redesign after a short construction period.

examples.fr: Avant les travaux, la place était surtout utilisée le soir.
examples.en: Mina: Before construction, the square was mostly used in the evening.

examples.fr: Oui, mais plusieurs résidents avaient signalé le manque d'ombre.
examples.en: Louis: Yes, but several residents had reported the lack of shade.

examples.fr: La voie a été fermée pendant trois semaines.
examples.en: Mina: The lane was closed for three weeks.

examples.fr: On aurait dû annoncer plus tôt l'accès temporaire.
examples.en: Louis: The temporary access should have been announced earlier.

examples.fr: C'est vrai. La consultation suivante pourrait inclure les personnes à mobilité réduite.
examples.en: Mina: That's true. The next consultation could include people with reduced mobility.

examples.fr: Il faut aussi tenir compte des commerces qui dépendent des livraisons.
examples.en: Louis: We also need to consider shops that depend on deliveries.

examples.fr: Le compromis dépendra donc des besoins de plusieurs groupes.
examples.en: Mina: So the compromise will depend on several groups' needs.

steps.title: Comparing two locations
steps.body: A couple compares two fictional rental neighbourhoods before deciding what to visit.

examples.fr: Le premier logement est plus près du métro, alors que le second est plus calme.
examples.en: Awa: The first home is closer to the metro, whereas the second is quieter.

examples.fr: Lequel offre un accès plus simple aux services ?
examples.en: Sam: Which one offers easier access to services?

examples.fr: Le premier, mais le loyer dépasse notre budget.
examples.en: Awa: The first one, but the rent exceeds our budget.

examples.fr: Dans ce cas, il faut comparer le coût total et les déplacements.
examples.en: Sam: In that case, we need to compare total cost and commutes.

examples.fr: D'accord. On visitera les deux avant de choisir.
examples.en: Awa: Agreed. We will visit both before choosing.
